text:
laura: Quick check-in on the on-prem preflight UI. Goal: make the networking step feel lightweight for new users but powerful for infra folks. Questions: collapse advanced options by default? how to show test breakdown without overwhelming?

samir: My take: progressive disclosure. Show the minimal fields (Hostname/IP, CIDR) and a small \u201cAdvanced\u201d chevron that expands: tags, MTU, custom routes. Keep primary CTA "Next" and a secondary "Run quick test" inline.

josh: +1. For the test UI, prefer an inline result row under the inputs instead of a modal or toast. A concise row with three chips: DNS, TCP, TLS. Each chip gets color + microtext (latency ms). Clicking a chip expands a tiny panel with logs.

ashley: Accessibility notes: chips need focus styles and keyboard reachable toggles. If a chip expands details, ensure it traps focus within the detail panel and returns focus to the chip on close. Use aria-expanded on the chip and aria-controls for the panel.

laura: Copy help: current wording says "we will validate your network" which reads scary. Proposed: "Quick connectivity check: we attempt DNS, TCP, and TLS to the address you provide. Results help us suggest fixes." Better?

samir: Slight tweak: "Quick connectivity check — DNS, TCP, TLS. If any step fails, we'll show targeted debug hints (e.g., DNS config, routing, cert mismatch)." Short and scannable.

josh: Implementation detail: when user enters an IP instead of hostname, skip DNS chip and label it "IP provided". Also store TLS fingerprint when available so ops teams can verify cert chains offline.

laura: Is showing TLS fingerprint in the UI ok? Could be sensitive. Maybe show a truncated fingerprint and a copy button, plus a tooltip about security.

ashley: If we show fingerprints, present them as preformatted text and include a "copy" button with aria-live announcement "fingerprint copied". Avoid auto-select on focus.

josh: For failure states: prefer contextual hints under the failing chip, not one generic banner. Eg DNS fail -> show "Try switching to the FQDN or add A/AAAA record". TCP fail -> port block troubleshooting steps and a link to firewall docs. TLS fail -> show cert subject and reason (expired/mismatch).

laura: UX nit: microcopy for "Advanced" should be "Advanced network settings (optional)" so users know it's safe to skip. Also increase helper text size to 13px as ashley flagged before.

ci-bot: preview deployed: https://staging.redwood.example/wizard/preflight/1771112223 :white_check_mark:

samir: One more accessibility nit: color alone should not indicate pass/fail. Add icons (check, x, info) and text labels (Pass, Fail, Warning). Also ensure status row is announced when results arrive (aria-live="polite").

laura: Action items: Samir update Figma to include chip-expand pattern + truncated fingerprint demo. Josh add test endpoint to backend, support IP-mode skip DNS and fingerprint truncation. Ashley to draft ARIA snippets and keyboard flow. I'll sync Friday 11am PT to sign off. Thanks team! :sparkles:
